title_zh: WebXSkill：面向自主网页智能体的技能学习
one_line: Distils synthetic agent trajectories into verified parameterised skills with step guidance, URL-graph retrieved; gains on WebArena, WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web incl. cross-site transfer.
